description: This Java class defines an abstract custom view for an Android keyboard application, extending functionality to include extra drawing capabilities via a list of ExtraDraw objects, with support for animation levels and custom invalidation logic.

classes.name: AnyKeyboardViewWithExtraDraw
classes.description: An abstract custom view class for Android keyboards that supports additional drawing operations and animation levels.

methods.name: addExtraDraw
methods.description: Adds an ExtraDraw object to the list of extra drawings to be rendered during the view's draw cycle, considering current animation level and configuration.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the default onDraw method to perform standard drawing and then iterate through extra draw objects, removing those that are completed and scheduling further redraws if needed.
